{{Infobox auto}}

'''Kontomire-dandelion stew''' is a stew that heals {{Value|Kontomire-Dandelion Stew|heals}} and grants {{EffectLink|Strength}} for {{Value|Kontomire-Dandelion Stew|duration|effect=Strength}} and {{EffectLink|Regeneration}} for {{Value|Kontomire-Dandelion Stew|duration|effect=Regeneration}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/kontomire_stew.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
[[Tomatoes]], a dandelion, a fern, a [[Cooked Fish|cooked fish]] or [[Cooked Large Fish|cooked large fish]], an egg and a [[bowl]]. Picking up tomatoes or a bowl unlocks the recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating it takes {{Value|Kontomire-Dandelion Stew|eat_time}}, heals {{Value|Kontomire-Dandelion Stew|heals}} and gives Strength {{Value|Kontomire-Dandelion Stew|level|effect=Strength}} for {{Value|Kontomire-Dandelion Stew|duration|effect=Strength|format=clock}} and Regeneration {{Value|Kontomire-Dandelion Stew|level|effect=Regeneration}} for {{Value|Kontomire-Dandelion Stew|duration|effect=Regeneration|format=clock}}. The bowl is given back.

=== Trading ===
It is one of the foods a villager can ask for as its [[favorite food]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/favorite_food/food_trades/food_18.mcfunction}}</ref>

== Trivia ==
* Kontomire stew is a Ghanaian dish made with cocoyam leaves. The changelog: "DON'T BE MAD--listen--ferns were the closest thing I could think of to cocoyam".<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.10|quote=Kontomire-Dandelion Stew (DON'T BE MAD--listen--ferns were the closest thing I could think of to cocoyam)}}</ref>
